visibleIdentity: Normalized prompt, essential context, display, original picture model, sorted order tiles, fraction builder, number-sentence card pool, answer format and unit; excludes answers, distractor order, hints, solutions and generated keys.
sampling: Round-robin all 211 task configurations. Sample ordinal floor(draw/211), index=ordinal%6, seed=FNV1a(paper-50k-audit-v1:ordinal:parameter). Uses actual catalogue IDs.
scope: Independent visible-givens solvers, separate proof evaluation for numeric answers, accepted/rejected answers, deterministic regeneration, choice uniqueness, visible givens and steps, prompt length and P1 bounds. Not 50,000 authored questions, teacher review, exhaustive syllabus coverage or UI testing.
